card.name: Inside confidence interval numbers
card.fires_on: The space or decimal point inside the lower bound of a confidence interval after '95% CI', as in a relative risk or odds ratio. Weaker cases are a few linking words in risk statements.

modes.label: Confidence interval numbers
modes.description: The space or decimal point right at the start of the lower limit of a 95% CI.
modes.example: years, the relative risk for ovarian cancer for CE plus MPA versus placebo was 1.58 (95% confidence interval (CI),<< >>0.77–3.2

modes.label: Linking word before screening
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'patients' in a statement about screening before antidepressant treatment.
modes.example: prior to initiating treatment with an antidepressant, patients<< with>> depressive symptoms should be adequately screened to determine

card.writes: It suppresses words of likelihood or doubt such as 'likely' and 'presumably', so it adds little about probability wording.
card.plain: It fires inside the numbers of a 95% confidence interval in risk results.
